description: This file implements a DataDog integration logger class for a Python project. The class handles batching and sending logs and events to DataDog via API or Agent, including success, failure, and health check reports. It includes methods for configuring connections, creating payloads, and handling asynchronous log transmission. The code is specific to the DataDog logging and monitoring system and integrates with project-specific utilities and types.
